notes.patterns: A shell command, or a command prefix followed by ' *', which also matches the bare command. No other wildcard is allowed.
notes.common: Rules every profile receives. The commands of the quality profiles in gates.json are allowed too.
notes.profiles: Rules added for the active profile, read from defaults.execution_profile in config.yaml. Run `jotta adapter <agent>` after a change.
notes.precedence: deny wins over ask, and ask wins over allow, in every agent. The deny list of permissions.md is enforced by the hooks and never relaxed here.
